senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; v. לָבַן) white; white color, white substance.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 73:10">Gen. R. s. 73</cite> <he>בן ל׳</he> a white child, opp. <cite ref="K00402"><he>כּוּשִׁי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 4:1">Men. IV, 1</cite> <he>התכלת … את הל׳</he> the absence of the blue fringe is no obstacle to using the white one &c.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 31:8">Lev. R. s. 31</cite> <he>אין אדם רואה מתוך הל׳ וכ׳</he> man does not see through the white (of the eye).
<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 7:4">Ib. VII, 4</cite>, a. fr. <he>בגדי ל׳</he> garments of white stuff.

<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 7:1">Ib. 1</cite>, v. <cite ref="A02381"><he>אִסְטַלִּית</he></cite>; a. v. fr.—<he>שְׂדֵה</he> (<cite ref="E00000"><he>ה</he></cite>)<he>ל׳</he> a bright, shadeless field, vegetable or grain field, opp. <he>שדה אילן</he> orchard.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 2:1">Shebi. II, 1</cite>; M. Kat. I, 4ᶜ; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="L00037"><he>לְבָנִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="L00110"><he>לְבָנִין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 8:2">Mikv. VIII, 2</cite> (<cite ref="M01199"><he>מים</he></cite>) <he>ל׳ נמשכים</he> white and cohesive matter (urin).
Tosef. Sabb. I, 22 הל׳ white garments, opp. צבועין colored; a. fr.—Fem. לְבָנָה.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 6:1:15">Y. Shek. VI, 49ᵈ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:11">Cant. R. to V, 11</cite> <he>אש ל׳</he> white fire. Sifra Thazr., Neg., Par. 5, ch. XIII <he>מה פשתים ל׳ אף צמר ל׳</he> as ‘linen’ means ‘of natural white color’, so does ‘wool’ &c.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 73:12">Gen. R. s. 73</cite> <he>שחורה או ל׳</he> is it the portrait of a black or of a white person?; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="L00109"><he>לְבָנוֹת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Makkot 20b:5">Macc. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>במלקט ל׳ וכ׳</he> when he plucks the gray hair from among the black.
